channel.title: The Margin Wars | The Rulebook Wire / UK / EU [Preview]
channel.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review — official sources, practical moves.

item.title: EU PSR: Council first-reading position
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents adoption of its first-reading position on 29 October. This is a legislative milestone, not an application date. PSD3 and PSR must be tracked separately; no implementation date is asserted here. Who: EU payment providers; not automatically UK firms. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15154-2026-INIT/en/pdf

item.title: PSD3: a separate Council milestone
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Council voting record documents its first-reading position on the payment and electronic-money services directive on 29 October. This is not an implementation deadline. Who: EU payment and e-money institutions; not automatically UK firms. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://data.consilium.europa.eu/doc/document/ST-15152-2026-INIT/en/pdf

item.title: UK scheme pricing: evidence required
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Relevant scheme-fee decisions must comply with the PSR’s pricing-governance direction from the end of November. Who: Visa, Mastercard and UK acquirers. Effective: 2026-11-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

item.title: UK fee transparency: next stage
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Substantive information, transparency and complexity requirements apply from the end of July 2027, subject to the limited fee-logic extension. Who: Visa, Mastercard and UK acquirers. Effective: 2027-07-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/publications/policy-statements/ps261-market-review-of-card-scheme-and-processing-fees-final-decision-information-transparency-and-complexity-remedy-pricing-governance-remedy/

item.title: Small fee lines: a limited extension
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. ITC Standard B is deferred for qualifying fee lines generating £850,000 or less in annual UK gross revenue. During the extension, acquirers can request that information without charge. Who: UK acquirers and scheme billing teams. Effective: 2029-07-30. Official source: https://www.psr.org.uk/media/nqoettxg/ps26-1-sp-fees-market-review-extensions-decision-aug-2026.pdf

item.title: Safeguarding: the operating baseline
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. Daily reconciliations, monthly reports and resolution packs form part of the strengthened safeguarding regime. Audit requirements have exceptions. Who: UK payment and e-money firms. Effective: 2026-05-07. Official source: https://www.fca.org.uk/firms/emi-payment-institutions-safeguarding-requirements

item.title: CHAPS: November release deferred
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. The Bank of England deferred its entire November 2026 RTGS standards release. This notice does not establish a replacement deadline. Who: CHAPS and RTGS participants. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news/2026/august/delay-to-the-november-2026-rtgs-standards-release
